$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-SAF-006 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §7.7 and the RF-SAF-006 inventory entry. Expresses blocking/uncertainty STRUCTURE only for suspected avulsion, full-thickness injury, or unresolved postoperative restriction. Blocks rehabilitation while the serious structural concern or postoperative restriction is unresolved. No diagnosis, surgical advice, treatment/return timing, rehab authorization, dosage, progression, confidence, or raw-imaging interpretation. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.
rule_title: Suspected avulsion, full-thickness injury, or postoperative restriction

input_contract.$comment: Structural trigger taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §7.7. Activated only by a strong current report or anchor — reported/external descriptors, never raw-imaging interpretation.

decision_contract.$comment: Blocking structure only. Sets REHAB_BLOCKED while restrictions are unresolved; routes per actual restrictions; does not issue a generic strain plan. No rehab authorization, no diagnosis, no surgical/treatment/return timing, no numeric values.

notes: Mixed normative source; MUST; permitted_use logic_with_uncertainty. Evidence grades preserved per source: QRF-012 (C1), QRF-032 (C1), QRF-036 (I1). Safety-state choice: v1.2 §7.7 explicitly assigns REHAB_BLOCKED while current management restrictions, weight-bearing limits, activity limits, or the external plan are unresolved; this is the resolvable REHAB_BLOCKED state (blocked_targets ['rehab']; V3.1 §21). Per §7.7 prohibited inference: do not choose operative versus nonoperative management and do not predict an individual timeline from pooled case-series means. The rule is activated only by a strong current report/anchor and must not interpret raw imaging (V3.1 §6 anchor model; §25 media-state hardening). Postoperative and nonoperative cases are routed per their actual restrictions; no generic strain plan is issued. Clearance only via a valid external assessment and referral-resolution object (V3.1 §20). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
